_comment: The Tamil counterpart of run_set_levels.json: same student, same topic, same models, same levels - only `language_id` differs. Kept as its own file rather than an extra item in the English set so the two stay directly comparable, and so a language change never silently alters the English baseline. Arun speaks Tamil at home, so ta-IN is the language he would actually be taught in; `india` defaults to ta-IN anyway, but it is written out here because a default that matters should be visible in the run set.
